I couldn't find the digest, so I have no ticket number for Kwame. I told him so in a reply on his message in #coastal-team.

Today is 19 Oct, so a Coastal digest dated 2 Nov hasn't been written yet. I checked #coastal-team, #coastal-random and #general, which are the channels Kwame is in. None of them has a digest from Moss. The only digest-related post is Bettina's request for a Monday digest.

His port account comes up once, in #coastal-random on 13 Oct, when Sofia said it was "quiet for once". That note has no ticket and doesn't mention barge slip 7 sync.

I asked him to tell me if he meant a different date or place, and I didn't guess a number.
